name: friends-walk-v2
prompt: Vertical candid phone photo taken by a friend from 2 metres away beside an ordinary Korean lakeside path on an overcast autumn day. The reference woman in a faded navy sweatshirt is in three-quarter SIDE PROFILE looking down and laughing with eyes nearly closed while another female friend helps untangle a tote strap; a third friend walks ahead partly cropped. Waist-up loose composition, lake small in background. NOT a selfie, NO camera-facing smile, no spectacular alpine scenery.

name: friends-night-v2
prompt: Vertical quick rear-camera phone snapshot at an ordinary Korean convenience store at night. Reference woman in a plain grey zip hoodie, short bob, sitting sideways on plastic stool looking at her friend to the LEFT, mouth open mid-laugh, one hand holding a paper cup near lap. Two distinct adult friends chatting, one partially cut off by frame. Unflattering mixed fluorescent light, dark background, slightly missed focus and natural motion softness. NOT a selfie, no outstretched camera arm, no posed V signs.
